purpose: Reference directory for human-reviewed Rent to Buy and London affordable-rent discovery. This is not a live availability feed.

requirement.verification: Confirm scheme, property type, bedroom count, rent, location, availability, eligibility and purchase route directly with provider.

sources.name: GOV.UK Rent to Buy how to apply
sources.role: Official provider search and local council/housing association guidance

sources.name: Homes for Londoners property search
sources.role: Official portal; filter renting schemes, London Living Rent or intermediate rent, beds, property type, monthly cost and availability

sources.name: Mayor of London London Living Rent information
sources.role: Official scheme terms, eligibility and rent benchmark context

sources.name: Notting Hill Genesis London Living Rent
sources.role: Provider scheme page; availability must be checked live

sources.name: RHP London Living Rent
sources.role: Provider scheme explanation and advertised route

sources.name: Kent Homechoice registered provider partners
sources.role: Provider directory for Kent; not itself proof of Rent to Buy inventory

safety: Search results and provider directory links are research signals, not confirmed homes.

London Living Rent is a distinct London intermediate-rent route; its pathway may involve shared ownership, so it must not be treated as satisfying a strict no-shared-ownership requirement without explicit user acceptance.
No automatic outreach or Smartsheet writes.
